\"The Nintendo DS ROM directory depth al.reason: Bounds FNT directory nesting (64 levels) so deeply nested 127-byte directory names cannot expand a single path prefix to ~512 KiB before member path retention.

\"The Nintendo DS ROM expanded path allo.reason: Bounds aggregate UTF-8 bytes of expanded FNT member paths (16 MiB) before allocation so 61,440 files under deep prefixes cannot expand an 8 MiB FNT into gigabytes of retained path strings.

\"The wxapkg directory-and-chunk I/O wor.reason: Four times the admitted member count plus 64 KiB chunks of declared member bytes, which artifact_limits.expanded_bytes bounds; it grows with that admission.

\"The .NET bundle exact integer range\".reason: A bundle offset or size above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cannot be represented exactly as a JavaScript number.

\"Node SEA duplicate-blob verification a.reason: Duplicate-blob verification work is bounded by the carrier's own file size, so the bound grows with the admitted input.

\"The ELF unwind symbol-name text allowa.reason: The 16 MiB symbol-name text decoded for one returned page is a resource policy; a smaller page (limit) stays within it.

\"The binary hardening table-entry allow.reason: The ELF dynamic table entry count is a resource policy; symbol-table excess already degrades to unresolved rows.

\"The lipo field retention allowance\".reason: lipo fields are sliced from its captured output, and their retention is bounded by the same native command output allowance; it changes only with that capture allowance.

\"The packet-tool output capture allowan.reason: Bounds only capinfos and tshark version and summary probes, whose replies are short fixed-format text; each tshark JSON pass reports producer_limits.output_bytes instead.

\"The packet-inventory retained-fact all.reason: tshark JSON decoding, expansion, retained-fact, output and snapshot allowances are producer budgets.

\"Sensitive terminal redaction\".reason: Sensitive terminal redaction state is a resource policy.

ceiling.name.reason: Relays the whole-file identity ceiling its caller names: 4 GiB minus one byte for PE-only readers, whose file offsets are 32-bit (format), and the 512 MiB artifact-size bound of the hardening and exports result schemas. max_file_bytes, a per-call parameter with details.limit, bounds what the readers read.

`The SQLite worker diagnostic capture al.reason: Bounds stdout and stderr of REA's own SQLite worker, which answers through its reply file; only startup failures and runtime warnings reach these streams, and no database content or analysis result passes through them.

\"The SQLite value/record, SQL statement.reason: The 16 MiB value/record, statement and worker reply allowance bounds what the parent decodes from REA's SQLite worker; it is a resource policy that should become a per-call control together with the worker heap.

\"SQLite's result-column limit for this.reason: SQLite's own result-column limit (SQLITE_LIMIT_COLUMN) for the private connection, reported by the engine with the reply; REA does not set it.
